err.not_authorized: This device isn't allowed to access the library. Ask the owner to pair it.
err.not_paired: This device isn't paired with the storage computer yet.
err.disk_full: The storage computer's disk is full — backups are paused.
diag.online_relay: Connected via relay (slower than a direct link)
diag.storage_offline: The storage computer is offline. Last seen {last_seen}.
diag.pairing: Waiting for confirmation on the storage computer…
err.unsupported: The storage computer doesn't understand this request. One side may need an update.
err.backup_failed: Backing up hit a snag — it will retry automatically; nothing was lost.
err.pair_expired: Nobody confirmed this request on the computer in time, so it expired. Generate a new pairing code on the computer and scan again.
err.pair_restarted: The P-Pass service on the computer restarted and this pairing request was lost. Generate a new pairing code on the computer and scan again.
diag.desktop.pairing: A device is waiting for you to confirm pairing
diag.desktop.disk_full: This computer's disk is full — backups are paused
ui.offline_action: The background service isn't running. Click below to start it — backups and pairing will work after that.
ui.refresh_hint: This window refreshes every 3 seconds after start; if nothing happens, close the app and reopen it, then click again.
ui.pending_banner_text: "{name}" just scanned this computer's QR code. Is this a family member?
ui.qr_fallback: Can't scan? Copy the pairing string
ui.qr_phone_version: Phone app must be v0.3.1 or newer to scan this code
ui.qr_hint: The QR is valid for 10 minutes; after scanning, come back here and click Allow.
ui.update_installed: Update installed — press OK to restart P-Pass and apply it.
ui.update_check_failed: Couldn't check for updates ({err}). Please try again later.
ui.update_failed_file_locked: Update failed: a background process is still holding the app's files. Please close P-Pass completely (right-click the tray icon and choose "Stop background service"), then try updating again.
ui.update_relaunch_failed: The update is installed, but the app couldn't restart itself — quit P-Pass completely (tray menu → "Quit App") and open it again to finish.
ui.update_available_short: Update {version} available — click Check for updates to continue.
ui.shell_restart_needed: v{version} installed — restart the app to apply
ui.restart_service_hint: The background service is still running the old version. Restart it to switch to the new one — no reinstall needed.
ui.kernel_converge_deferred: Photos are transferring. The background service will switch to the new version automatically once this transfer finishes. Click “Restart now” to switch right away.
ui.kernel_converge_restarting: Switching the background service to the new version automatically — this takes a few seconds.
ui.restart_service_confirm_body: Ongoing backups/transfers will be interrupted and resume automatically after the restart. Restart anyway?
ui.restart_service_still_starting: The background service is still starting up (a large library can take ten-plus seconds on first launch). This notice disappears once the versions match — no need to click again.
ui.restart_service_no_change: The service restarted but the version is still {version} — the service file doesn't seem to have updated. Please reinstall the app.
ui.restart_service_failed: Failed to restart the background service: {err}
ui.logs_hint: The diagnostics package removes file paths and photo file names, public IP addresses, device identifiers and device names. It keeps timestamps and error messages so the developers can investigate.
ui.stop_hint: After stopping, the service won't auto-start and backups pause, and it stays stopped after reopening or updating the app; click "Start background service" to re-enable it.
ui.stop_confirm_body: Stopping cancels auto-start and pauses all backups; family phones can't connect until you re-enable it. Stop anyway?
ui.service_stopped: Background service stopped; it won't auto-start on boot.
ui.revoke_confirm_body: Remove device「{name}」? It will lose access immediately.
ui.change_body:
The library location will change to: {dir}

Note: the change takes effect after the background service restarts. Photos already backed up won't move (they stay in the current folder) — the new location starts empty. After switching, every paired phone must scan this computer's pairing code again; once confirmed, each phone re-uploads its photos to the new location, which can take a while for large libraries. Change?
ui.change_saved: Library location saved as {dir}; it takes effect after the background service restarts. Old photos stay in place — afterwards, please pair each phone again by scanning the code.
ui.logs_exported: Diagnostics exported (sanitized, ready to send to the developers): {path}
ui.library_dir_unknown: The background service has not reported the library location yet
ui.photos_count_path: {n} photos · stored as original files in {path}
ui.photos_empty: No photos yet. They'll appear here after a phone backup.
ui.devices_paired_line: Paired devices {n} · names can be changed to family nicknames, e.g. "Mom's phone"
ui.mobile_reupload_title: Files went missing on the storage computer — re-uploading
ui.mobile_reupload_body: If you deleted them on purpose, delete them on this phone first.
ui.library_delete_warn: {n} photo(s) were just deleted from the library. Any that still exist on a phone will be uploaded again on the next backup — to delete one for good, delete the original on the phone first, then delete it here.
ui.low_space_title: Photo library is running low on space
ui.low_space_body: Only {free} left on the photo library's disk (below 5 GB). Free up disk space or move the photo library to a bigger drive.
ui.conn_relay: Connected via relay — encrypted, the relay can't read it
ui.flow_relay: Transferring via relay (encrypted, the relay can't read it)
ui.presence_waiting: Waiting for the next backup report
ui.pending_new_hint: Is this a family member's phone? Once allowed, it will appear in the device list.
ui.pending_known_hint: This device has connected before. Allow it to resume backups.
ui.pending_sub_known: Has connected to this computer before
ui.disconnected_hint: Scan the QR code again to restore
ui.startup_migration_guidance: This version is older than your photo library. Please reinstall the newer version.
ui.audit_merged: Merged with old device (restored after reinstall)
ui.wizard_choose_folder_title: Choose a folder for your photos
ui.wizard_daemon_not_started: The background service failed to start. Check the background service logs.
ui.wizard_start_failed: Failed to start the background service: {err}
ui.wizard_library_title: Where should the family's photos live?
ui.wizard_library_body_mac: Pick a folder to be the "photo library". Photos are saved as original files, and you can browse them in Finder anytime.
ui.wizard_library_body_win: Pick a folder to be the "photo library". Photos are saved as original files, and you can browse them in File Explorer anytime.
ui.wizard_library_tip_mac: Avoid "Desktop" and "Documents" — macOS protects them, so you'd get an extra permission prompt, and they're harder to move when space runs out.
ui.wizard_library_tip_win: Avoid protected folders like "Program Files" on the system drive, and try not to pick a cloud-synced folder such as OneDrive — a folder in your own user directory, like "Pictures" or "Documents", is the easiest choice.
ui.wizard_sleep_body: Family phones send photos back while charging on Wi-Fi — the computer has to be on to receive them.
ui.wizard_sleep_never: This computer is set to never sleep automatically
ui.wizard_sleep_minutes: This computer sleeps after {n} minutes idle and can't receive backups while asleep.
ui.wizard_sleep_fix_failed_mac: {err} — you can also click "Open system settings" and turn it off yourself: searching "sleep" in the top-right search box is fastest, since the menu location differs between macOS versions.
ui.wizard_sleep_fix_failed_win: {err} — you can also click "Open system settings" and turn it off yourself: open "Power & sleep settings" and set both "Screen and sleep" options to "Never".
ui.wizard_power_unknown: Couldn't read this computer's power settings (nothing breaks): we keep it awake automatically while a backup is running.
ui.wizard_service_title: Last step: run it as a background service.
ui.wizard_service_body: P-Pass registers as a system background service: it starts at boot and keeps quietly receiving backups even after you close this window. You can stop it anytime in "Settings".
ui.wizard_asks_win: Start at login (a registry startup entry — no admin rights needed, and no Windows service is created)
ui.wizard_wont: No cloud uploads, no accounts — photos only travel between your family's devices
ui.wizard_blocked_mac: If macOS blocks the first launch: right-click the app → Open (only needed once)
ui.wizard_blocked_win: If Windows SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC" during install: click "More info" → "Run anyway" (the installer isn't signed yet, so this prompt is expected)
ui.device_no_backup_days: No backup for {n} days — open the app on that phone once and it will catch up
ui.tray_hint_body:
Closing the window doesn't stop backups — photos from family phones still come in.

To quit completely, right-click the P-Pass icon at the bottom right of the taskbar and choose "Quit".
ui.tray_hint_title: P-Pass is still running in the background
ui.reveal_failed: Couldn't show it in the file manager: {err}
ui.overview_title_count: The family's {n} photos, safe on this computer.
ui.overview_title: The family's photos, safe on this computer.
ui.add_device_body: Click to show a large pairing QR code, then scan it with P-Pass on a family phone. Once scanned, the code closes by itself — come back here and confirm with "Allow".
ui.devices_footnote: "Via relay" = when a direct link isn't possible, traffic goes through an encrypted relay; the relay can't see photo content, and it may be slower. Removing a device cuts its access immediately — dangerous actions live only on the computer.
ui.photos_footnote: Thumbnails are just for quick browsing; organize, export and delete in your file manager — they're ordinary files.
ui.log_subtitle: Who backed up what, at a glance — no need to cross-check in the file manager.
ui.log_empty: Nothing here yet. Pairing, backups and device removals will appear here in time order.
ui.log_footnote: Records come from this computer's photo library and audit log, and are never uploaded.
ui.library_change_hint: A new location takes effect after the background service restarts; backed-up photos won't move automatically, and every paired phone needs to scan the pairing code again.
ui.pair_qr_body: Scan this code with P-Pass on a family phone; its join request will show up here automatically.

ui.wizard_autostart_notice_mac: Start at login — macOS shows a one-time "Background Items Added" notification; nothing to do
ui.wizard_local_network_mac: Local network — macOS will ask whether “ppf-daemon” (P-Pass's background service) may find local network devices. Click "Allow".
